⛔ Not a claim, ⛔ not a dispatch. `finding` comes off.

- **In scope:**
  - The deletions: the test-only censuses, `eval-console.mjs`, `release-bump.cjs`, the unbuilt CLI aliases and the dead turbo inputs.
  - The `pnpm dedupe --check` replacement, kept report-only.

The maintainer answered the per-script recommendation in the card's project thread verbatim with 「全按推荐」. Recorded here so the seat can close the card.

**Finding behind the recommendation.** 7 of the 8 gate-shaped items are already enforced in CI. Each one's own test asserts the live tree is clean. `ui/scripts/**/*.test.ts` is in the ui vitest `unit` project (`ui/vitest.config.mts:398-403`), and `select-affected-tests.mjs` selects those tests always-on (`:42-47`), so every Test UI run carries them: every ui PR, every merge-queue build, and the full push/schedule runs. Two tests also pin that no workflow names the gate (`check-lint-rule-coverage.test.ts:683-697`, `check-hand-rolled-comment-mask.test.ts:253-261`), so adding a workflow step would red them. On main today the 9 test files pass: 219 tests.

| # | Script(s) | Ruling | Note |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | check-lint-rule-coverage | A, keep | enforced by its `this repository` test |
| 2 | check-unused-dependencies | A, keep | enforced by its `this repository` test |
| 3 | check-registry-bare-name-collisions | A, keep | enforced by its live-tree sweep test |
| 4 | check-comment-mask-corpus + check-hand-rolled-comment-mask | A, keep | hand-rolled is enforced; the corpus's 66 s full-tree sweep stays a hand-run report (the optional B wiring was not chosen) |
| 5 | check-ui-root-lookups | A, keep | enforced by its live-tree scan test |
| 6 | check-pending-changeset-literals | A, keep for now | enforced, but it scans `ui/.changeset`. **Revisit when #25831 moves ui's pending changesets to the root**: delete the gate or retarget it at the root `.changeset/` |
| 7+8 | body-dialect-census + body-dialect-producer-scan | A, keep | the `body` retirement (objectui#6771 option B) is not finished; tests pin app-metadata 0 and producers 0 |

The 3 live instruments (`tsconfig-test-parity-census`, `check-component-surface-parity`, `dollar-dialect-alias-census`) are **kept**. Source or test comments name each one, and the dollar census's test is the sole explicit reader that the objectui#9096 totality pin depends on.

Workload of the ruling: none. No code change follows from it. The card's code work is complete (#26004, #26024, #26057, #26098, #26107, #26139). The one carried item is the #6 revisit after #25831.
